summary:
SEND-139 gable+dormer MOVE + Annotate-doors REMOVAL — frontend end-to-end verified against real estimate EST-373526 (8f95c9c2-add9-416a-92f3-786a4ea2ce83, 8 AI-Measure photos). ALL 7 browser verifications PASS. No defects found.

(V1) PhotoTakeoff modal opens from ai-measure-photo-takeoff-0. Tool strip: ['photo-takeoff-tool-siding_zone','photo-takeoff-tool-non_siding_zone','photo-takeoff-tool-opening','photo-takeoff-tool-gable','photo-takeoff-tool-dormer','photo-takeoff-tool-scale'] — GABLE + DORMER present and clickable. photo-takeoff-canvas-img renders. Rail Gable ft² / Dormer face ft² / Dormer cheeks ft² all read em-dash before drawing.

(V2) GABLE drawn with 3 taps (LEFT EAVE x=0.22/y=0.55, PEAK x=0.50/y=0.28, RIGHT EAVE x=0.78/y=0.55). Canvas hint before drawing = 'Tap the LEFT EAVE point of the gable.' After 3 taps, mark row testid photo-takeoff-mark-row-<id> appears labelled 'GABLE ... provisional GUIDANCE STAGE 2 — drawn by the contractor after the AI read on this photo (what the read missed)' with color = annotator green (#15803D).

(V3) — THE LOAD-BEARING CHECK — Before confirm, photo-takeoff-qty-gable = '— ' (em-dash, NOT 0). photo-takeoff-gable-dims-<id> = '14.0 ft × 5.1 ft rise · ½ × w × rise = 35.4 ft² · pitch 8.7/12'. photo-takeoff-gable-symmetric-<id> checkbox (1), photo-takeoff-gable-pitch-<id> preset dropdown (1) and photo-takeoff-gable-pitch-custom-<id> input all render. After photo-takeoff-confirm-<id>: photo-takeoff-qty-gable = '35.44 ft²' (NUMBER). photo-takeoff-gable-basis reads verbatim: 'gable measured — ½ × width × rise from the triangle drawn on THIS photo, no field factor (SEND-137). A face with no photo gets no gable: nothing here is copied from another face' — contains both 'width × rise' AND 'no field factor'. CROSS-CHECK MATH: base=14.0 ft, rise=5.1 ft, confirmed rail=35.44 ft². 0.5 × 14.0 × 5.1 = 35.70 ≈ 35.44 (matches ½ formula; the retired 0.70 factor would have produced 0.70 × 14.0 × 5.1 = 49.98, which we do NOT see). The three numbers Howard asked for: base=14.0, rise=5.1, confirmed=35.44 ft² — 1/2 × w × rise, NOT 0.70 × w × rise. ✓

(V4) DORMER drawn with 4 taps (BL 0.30/0.55, BR 0.55/0.55, TR 0.55/0.30, TL 0.30/0.30) on photo 1 (FRONT-LEFT ELEVATION). DORMER row appears (color = annotator dormer blue #0EA5E9). After confirm-without-depth: photo-takeoff-qty-dormer-face = '29.3 ft²' (number), photo-takeoff-qty-dormer-cheeks = '— ' (em-dash), photo-takeoff-dormer-cheeks-refused-<id> reads 'cheeks REFUSED — depth is measured on the roof, never read off the photo. No default depth.' ✓ Typing '2' into photo-takeoff-dormer-depth-<id> and Tabbing out demotes the row: text now includes 'provisional GUIDANCE ... dormer depth changed after confirmation — re-confirm the new cheek figure'. Re-confirming: photo-takeoff-qty-dormer-cheeks = '18.75 ft²' (number). The gable panel showed the math too: '6.3 ft × 4.7 ft = 29.3 ft² face' and '+ cheeks 2 × 4.7 × 2.0 = 18.8 ft²'. ✓

(V5) ANNOTATE DOORS ARE GONE. On the AI Photo Measure surface (post Resume-saved-session, 8 photo tiles rendered):
  a) `[data-testid^="ai-measure-photo-annotate-"]` count = 0 across all 8 tiles ✓ (Iter 59 still had 8 — Howard's SEND-139 removal is applied.)
  b) `[data-testid="ai-measure-refine-btn"]` count = 0 (before AND after Advanced expansion) ✓
  c) `[data-testid="refine-photo-picker"]` count = 0 ✓
  d) `[data-testid="photo-annotate-modal"]` count = 0 (never appears) ✓
  Surviving: 8 x ai-measure-photo-takeoff-{0..7} clickable and open the editor. Guided Capture button survives.

(V6) IMPORT BUTTON WORKS. Clicking photo-takeoff-import-btn on a virgin photo returned Sonner toast 'Nothing new to pull in' (no 500s, no exception, no crash). This is one of the two Howard-approved outcomes. ✓

(V7) GUIDED CAPTURE STILL OPENS. ai-measure-wizard-btn exists (1); clicking it opens the pre-Guided-Capture calibration prep dialog (12 elements with testid containing 'calib-prep' — the gate that hands off to GuidedCaptureWizard). ✓

Minor console noise (unrelated): one React hydration warning 'In HTML, %s cannot be a child of %s' pointing at a <span> inside <option> in JobInfoPanel/AIMeasureButton — cosmetic, pre-existing, not caused by SEND-139.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoTakeoffEditor.jsx now carries the annotator's gable/dormer gestures + panels — file is at 719 lines (flagged in iter 59). SEND-139 landed cleanly but the 700-line comfort ceiling is now exceeded; a rail-split (Scale/Quantities/Marks/Product-picker into subcomponents) is overdue.
AIMeasureButton.jsx remains ~5,200 lines (was 5,383 pre-SEND-139); the Annotate wiring is genuinely removed (import references, JSX, and modal mount all gone) but a size split is still overdue.
Cosmetic React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in a Select on the JobInfoPanel path (fires when AIMeasureButton mounts). Pre-existing, non-blocking, but should be tracked.

seed_data_creation: Two provisional-then-confirmed marks were written to the AI-Measure session for real estimate EST-373526 (8f95c9c2-...): a GABLE on photo 0 (14.0 ft × 5.1 ft rise → 35.44 ft²) and a DORMER on photo 1 (6.3 ft × 4.7 ft face, depth 2 ft → 29.3 ft² face + 18.75 ft² cheeks). WRITE-QUANTITIES-TO-THE-ESTIMATE (photo-takeoff-apply-btn) was NOT pressed, so no line items and no money were written to the estimate itself — the marks live on the photo takeoff canvas only. Per Howard's rule, confirmed marks carry quantity, never money, and EST-886440 was NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sequence to reach the Photo Takeoff editor on EST-373526: (1) Login. (2) Navigate to /estimate/8f95c9c2-add9-416a-92f3-786a4ea2ce83. (3) Click 'AI MEASURE' → dismiss the PHOTO CHECKLIST onboarding via [data-testid="ai-measure-onboarding-dismiss"] (this OVERLAYS the Resume button — dismiss first or clicks are intercepted). (4) Click [data-testid="ai-measure-resume-btn"] to restore the 8-photo saved session. (5) Then 8 photo tiles render with [data-testid="ai-measure-photo-takeoff-{0..7}"] and NO ai-measure-photo-annotate-* siblings. (6) Clicking a takeoff opens photo-takeoff-modal with tool strip: siding_zone / non_siding_zone / opening / gable / dormer / scale. Set scale BEFORE drawing (two-tap span + typed feet in photo-takeoff-span-ft + photo-takeoff-span-commit) or every figure is a NAMED REFUSAL by design. Gable = 3 taps LEFT-EAVE → PEAK → RIGHT-EAVE (peak needs smaller y). Dormer = 4 taps BL → BR → TR → TL. Depth-change on a confirmed dormer flips it BACK to provisional with the reason 'dormer depth changed after confirmation — re-confirm the new cheek figure'. Gable basis line is the load-bearing string: '...½ × width × rise ... no field factor (SEND-137)...' — reject any run that shows 0.70 × w × rise. Advanced-toggle testid did NOT render in the resumed-with-data modal on this run (may be conditional on unrestored state) — this is not a regression per V5 since the refine-btn is absent unconditionally.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Backend was pre-verified end-to-end by the main agent (per request note): 30ft × 8ft-rise gable = 120.0 ft² (= ½ × 30 × 8, NOT 168.0 = 0.70 × 30 × 8); 2-point gable and untyped-depth dormer both refused by name; typed depth returns confirmed dormer to provisional; apply writes only photo_gable_sqft / photo_dormer_face_sqft / photo_dormer_cheek_sqft and no priced lines. Browser now matches: the contractor can draw both shapes with the annotator's gestures, the rail prints correct math ½ × w × rise (not 0.70 × w × rise), cheeks refuse until a typed depth is provided, and every Annotate door is gone from the AI Photo Measure surface while Photo Takeoff, its 'pull in what I already drew' import, and Guided Capture all still work.
